## History

Magog, along with [Gog](../character/gog.md), originally ruled over the hearth's fortunes at Tabby's Place. When Captain Saul [Garrick](../character/uncle-saul.md) spent time in the small dwelling, he developed a strong fondness for Magog and [Gog](../character/gog.md) as they maintained their hearth duties with grace and composure.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P2](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0002)_
